notes: ACCESS: robots.txt has no full-site Disallow and no anthropic/Claude-specific block; tier (a) HTTP fetch (curl w/ browser UA) worked for most pages. TREE: built from union of (1) sitemap-index -> sitemap-categories-1/2.xml (all /categories/ URLs), (2) the full mega-menu nav extracted from a product page's SSR HTML (Next.js RSC stream, 231 nav links covering every top-level section: Chandeliers&Pendants, Bath&Wall Lights, Ceiling Lights, Fans, Outdoor Lights, Lamps&Shades, Mirrors&Decor, Furniture, Rugs, New&Inspiring, Sale), and (3) product-page breadcrumbs used to confirm the canonical category of ambiguous nodes. Site is primarily lighting/lamps/mirrors/furniture; Rugs is a full top-level nav section, and Pillows/Throws exist as sitemap-only categories under Mirrors&Decor>Decor (not linked in the live mega-menu but reachable and indexed). QTY: primary source was the site's own category-API JSON embedded in the SSR payload (self.__next_f RSC stream field "initialProductResult":{"total":N,...,"title":...}) - this is the same field powering the visible "N items" header. Cross-checked with Playwright headless-Chromium renders (counting actual product-card links in the grid) for the pillow pages (0/0/0/2 items rendered, matching JSON) and 2 rug pages (animal-prints-hide-rugs: JSON 7 = rendered 7; magnolia-home-rugs: JSON/rendered-cards 5, but the page's own visible header read '7 items' - kept JSON/card-count value 5 and flagged MEDIUM since it is corroborated by two independent measurements against the single conflicting header text). EXCLUDED: All Rugs/Shop All Rugs (all-rugs, dup URL, parent w/ valid subcategories per textile.md Sec25), Clearance Sale Rugs (promotional/sale collection, textile.md Sec27), Rug Pads (rug-pads - underlayment/accessory, not itself a textile/floor-covering product, analogous to hardware exclusion), non-nav sitemap style variants of Rugs not present in the live mega-menu (boho-rugs, transitional-rugs, industrial-rugs, rustic-rugs, kids-rugs, round-rugs, solid-rugs, exclusive-rugs, new-rugs, featured-rugs, customer-favorite-rugs, organic-opulence, ed-ellen-degeneres-rugs, whimsical-lighting-rugs-home-decor, boho-outdoor-lighting-rugs-decor, exclusive-lighting-rugs-decor - overlapping style/marketing tag pages, not the canonical construction/material-based subcategory set the live nav actually uses); Boho Pillows & Throws, Kids & Nursery Pillows & Throws, Outdoor Pillows & Poufs - real, currently-live category pages (confirmed via HTTP total=0 AND Playwright render showing 0 product cards each) but with zero current products, omitted per textile.md Sec34 (no empty category records) rather than emitted as qty=0 rows - noted here instead. STORAGE: no genuine Storage/Organization nav section or sitemap category exists anywhere on the site. The only cabinet-adjacent sitemap categories are storage-display-cabinets (breadcrumb on its own products resolves to FURNITURE > All Furniture, e.g. bosie-cabinet), medicine-cabinets (breadcrumb resolves to MIRRORS & HOME DECOR > MIRRORS > All Mirrors, e.g. littleton-medicine-cabinet-mirror), bathroom-vanity-cabinets-sinks (bathroom fixture/furniture, includes sinks), and dressers-chests (bedroom furniture) - all four are explicitly categorized by the site itself as Furniture or Mirrors, not Storage, per storage.md Sec21/Sec14/Sec28, so storage_rows is empty.
